name: Zernio
tagline: Developer API for 15+ social platforms plus messaging infra: WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, voice calls, and provisionable phone numbers

pricing.notes: First 2 accounts free, then graduated: $6/account (3-10), $3 (11-100), $1 (101+). Every feature on every plan. Phone numbers, SMS, and calls metered separately; X/Twitter API costs passed through at cost.

tiers.name: 1–2 connected social accounts
tiers.limits: First 2 social accounts free forever; full API, unlimited posts, analytics and inbox; $12 monthly usage credit
tiers.notes: Usage-based communications and X API pass-through charges can still consume the included credit.

tiers.name: Accounts 3–10
tiers.limits: $6 per connected account/month in this marginal band; full API and unlimited posting
tiers.notes: This is a marginal per-account rate, not a flat total.

tiers.name: Accounts 11–100
tiers.limits: $3 per connected account/month in this marginal band; full API and unlimited posting
tiers.notes: Earlier accounts retain their earlier-band rates.

tiers.name: Accounts 101–2,000
tiers.limits: $1 per connected account/month in this marginal band; full API and unlimited posting
tiers.notes: Daily proration applies when accounts are connected or removed.

tiers.name: Accounts 2,001+
tiers.limits: $1 per connected account/month with no published account ceiling
tiers.notes: Contact sales is optional; the public rate remains usage-based.

pricing.freeTierCaps: 2 connected social accounts free forever, with $12/month of included usage credit
pricing.billingTerms: monthly usage billing only, no annual plan; connected accounts are prorated daily
pricing.hiddenCosts: X is billed at exact pass-through usage (for example $0.005/read, $0.015 create, $0.200 create-with-URL, $0.010 DM read and $0.015 DM send). Active ads above 500 cost $0.01/ad/month. Phone numbers cost $3–$21/month; calls, SMS/RCS, recording and transcription are metered; US 10DLC starts with $9 setup plus about $4/month/campaign; WhatsApp bills through Meta. Automatic usage charges begin at a $10 threshold.

verdictSummary: The scheduler is the easy 10 percent and an agent can build it in a sitting. The other 90 percent is approval-gated: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, YouTube, and Pinterest publishing all require a reviewed developer app (Meta App Review, TikTok audit, LinkedIn partner access), and X's API starts at $200/mo. Past the gate, the real product is upkeep: OAuth token refresh and revocation handling across 15 networks, per-platform media validation and transcoding, rate-limit cooldowns, and error remediation when platforms change behavior. Then there is the half that is not software at all: Zernio provisions real phone numbers across dozens of countries and runs WhatsApp Business, SMS, RCS, and voice calling on them, which means carrier relationships, per-country regulatory documents, and Meta business verification. No coding agent can conjure a phone number or pass KYC for you. Add the rest of the surface (unified DM/comment inbox, analytics, ads management across six ad platforms) and this is infra plus compliance, not a weekend of code.
coreLoopDIY: Expose a small REST API that accepts a post with media and a schedule time, queues it, and publishes to networks with open APIs (Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord, Reddit) with retries and per-target status.
diyTimeEstimate: not a true replacement; consolation build in a weekend
requirements: reviewed developer app per closed platform (Meta App Review, TikTok audit, LinkedIn partner program, Pinterest; X API paid tier)
OAuth flows plus token storage, refresh, and revocation handling
hosted scheduler, database, and job queue
media storage with per-platform validation and transcoding
for messaging: WhatsApp Business API access, phone numbers with per-country KYC, and SMS/voice carrier contracts (or reselling Twilio, the kind of subscription you were replacing)
whatYouLose: publishing to approval-gated networks at all (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, YouTube) without your own reviewed apps
token lifecycle handling: refresh, revocation detection, reconnect flows across 15 networks
platform error remediation, retry logic, and rate-limit cooldowns that keep queues alive
the media pipeline: per-platform validation, compression, transcoding, re-hosting
the entire messaging stack: phone numbers provisioned per country with KYC handled, WhatsApp Business templates and broadcasts, SMS, RCS, and voice calling
everything else beyond posting: unified DM/comment/review inbox, contacts, analytics, ads APIs, conversion tracking
moatNotes: Approved platform apps and their review processes gate the social side; phone numbers, carrier contracts, and per-country KYC gate the messaging side. Ongoing multi-network API maintenance is the tax on both.
whyPeopleStillPay: You are not paying for scheduling code, you are paying for two things code cannot get you. First, publishing through someone else's approved platform apps without going through six app reviews yourself, plus the long tail those approvals unlock: DM and comment inboxes, analytics, ads creation and reporting across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and X. Second, telecom: phone numbers provisioned in dozens of countries with regulatory paperwork handled, running WhatsApp Business with templates and broadcasts, SMS, RCS, and voice calls behind the same REST API. Ironically its main buyers are vibe coders: people who build their own app in a weekend and mount Zernio for the parts that cannot be vibecoded.

notes: API infra play: the code is replaceable; the platform approvals, phone numbers, and carrier compliance are not.
prompt:
Build me a personal social publishing API to replace Zernio. Requirements:

- Node + Fastify + better-sqlite3, single API key from .env, runs on my
  always-on box.
- Adapters ONLY for networks that hand out credentials on signup: Bluesky
  (app password via @atproto/api), Mastodon (access token), Telegram channel
  (bot token), Discord (webhook URL), Reddit (script app). One small adapter
  file per network so a sixth is addable later; scaffold nothing I don't use.
- POST /posts accepts text, image URLs, scheduledFor (ISO, my timezone), and
  a list of target accounts; media is downloaded once to media/ and checked
  for type and size before the post is accepted.
- A node-cron tick every minute publishes due posts: mark a row as sending
  before publishing so nothing ever double-posts, per-target status, 3
  retries with backoff, partial failures don't block other targets.
- GET /posts and GET /posts/:id return queue state and per-network
  permalinks; a plain localhost page lists the queue and recent failures.
- Optional webhook: POST to a URL from .env on published and failed.
- Binds to localhost only. No accounts, no telemetry.
- Out of scope: the approval-gated networks (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn,
  Threads, YouTube, Pinterest), DMs, comments, analytics, and ads. Skip
  anything that needs a phone number (WhatsApp, SMS, calls): numbers,
  carrier access, and KYC cannot be vibecoded.
- README: how to get each credential (Bluesky app password, Mastodon token,
  Telegram bot via BotFather, Reddit script app), plus an honest note that
  the closed networks need app review or paid API tiers.
